people.name: Kidron
people.line: A valley east of Jerusalem, site of significant events

translations.web: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron, know for certain that you will surely die. Your blood will be on your own head.”
translations.bsb: On the day you go out and cross the Kidron Valley, know for sure that you will die; your blood will be on your own head.”
translations.kjv: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
translations.asv: For on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, know thou for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
